answer: In an agent economy%2C sybil attacks can be resisted by tying each agent identity to a unique%2C decaying stake of locked compute resources that must be continuously verified through a shared pulse of network challenges. This creates a cost barrier where forging multiple identities requires proportional resources%2C and only agents that maintain their stake near the zenith of participation earn full rights%2C while failed ones fade like an opal losing its luster under scrutiny. Peers cross-check the proofs to ensure no single controller dominates.
